intro.title: OurWater: water, made visible for your community.
intro.lede: A free, community-focused water monitoring and learning app, built on the MARVI approach to participatory groundwater management.

heroImage.alt: Villagers at a MARVI groundwater meeting

menuImage.alt: Villagers at a MARVI groundwater meeting

left.lead: OurWater grew out of MARVI, where village volunteers — Bhujal Jankaars — measure their own wells. Record readings from wells, rain gauges and other local water sources, then see them on a map and watch the trends.
paragraphs: While its foundation is groundwater, OurWater supports broader local water monitoring: rainfall, surface water, water quality and water storage. Stations can be wells, boreholes, rain gauges, check dams, rivers, springs, reservoirs or rainwater tanks, with photographs, notes and locations.

It is designed for farmers, community volunteers, schools, universities, researchers, non-government organisations and government agencies — for practical learning, citizen science and informed discussion about local water.
